beats.care: Writing both? Check both hall tickets and watch for a TGPSC notice on dates.
beats.what: TGPSC's AEE (Civil) exam is on Nov 6–7. SSC's JE test runs Nov 2–6.
beats.why: Rao says many SSC JE centres are in other states, so returning in time is hard.

cards.body: BRS MLA Harish Rao wrote to CM Revanth Reddy asking TGPSC to move the AEE exam. Roads Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy had asked TGPSC to review dates on Oct 14. Aspirants protested at TGPSC on Oct 17. No new dates yet.

cards.q: Should TGPSC move the AEE exam?

cards.why: AEE posts are for engineers in state departments like Roads and Buildings.

hook: Two engineering exams clash in *Nov 6* week

learn.t: TGPSC hires for Telangana government posts. SSC hires for central government posts.

sources.name: Siasat

topic: AEE vs SSC JE exam clash
